purpose: Source-only continuation of the frozen Binance V1.7 historical fixed contract pool to the OKX-aligned 2026-11-08 12:00 UTC boundary. No signals, strategy replay, or PnL are produced.
single_variable: Extend source OHLCV coverage after the original 2026-09-23 cutoff while preserving the fixed 680-symbol historical pool and each official contract lifecycle.

fixed_universe.membership_rule: Use the frozen archive-complete files only. Do not replace the pool with the currently active Binance symbol list.
fixed_universe.lifecycle_rule: For the 632 original contracts, retain archived onboard dates and use current exchangeInfo delivery dates only when the onboard date is unchanged. A changed onboard date is a separate relisted period. For the 19 supplemental contracts use their frozen onboard/delivery evidence. Keep the 29 archive-only historical members in coverage with their observed archive boundary, explicitly labeled as an observed archive boundary and not an official delivery date; do not join them to current same-name tickers without official lifecycle evidence.
fixed_universe.known_relisting: MDTUSDT has a 2023-06 original onboard and 2024-05 archived delivery, plus a separate 2026-10-21 current onboard. The latter is a separate period and has no claimed September lineage.

local_5m_ohlcv_priority: data/crypto/market/binance_um5m_rest_fallback/series (only if a cache has complete OHLCV columns)
sources.excluded_local_data: OHLC-only/OHLCV-incomplete cache rows are recorded as excluded and never padded. The huge preholdout series is not scanned for this short continuation; official FAPI fills a missing overlap day instead.

official_fallback.request_window: one UTC day per symbol/lifecycle gap, startTime inclusive, endTime inclusive

sources.old_h1_reference: experiments/active/exp-cloud-close-binance-transfer-20261109-v1/work/<symbol>/quotes.npz; compare common OHLC opens in the 2026-09-22 through 2026-09-23 overlap window

construction.period_validity: Use candle opens in [ceil(onboardDate, 5m), deliveryDate), additionally clipped to the configured collection range. OPEN_MAX means no known delivery. A changed official onboard date creates an independent period id; no price series crosses that boundary.
construction.h1_aggregation: Aggregate only 12 exact consecutive 5m UTC opens in [hour_open, hour_open+60m): open=first, high=max, low=min, close=last, volume=sum, close_volume_sum_5m=sum(5m close * 5m base volume). Emit H1 only if the whole hour is within the contract lifecycle. No interpolated or forward-filled candles.
construction.volume_proxy_definition: close_volume_sum_5m is a frozen seven-day turnover proxy required by the original signal feature interface; it is not Binance quote-asset volume and must remain separately named.
construction.gaps: Keep missing 5m bars and incomplete H1 hours absent, with expected/observed counts, samples, local source presence, REST result, and affected period recorded in coverage and source audit.
construction.zero_volume: Retain official zero-volume 5m bars and count them; volume is not inferred from price movement.
construction.source_conflicts: Compare duplicate local OHLCV records; choose the documented higher-priority source only after recording duplicate/conflicting timestamps and examples. REST is highest priority for the rows it fills.

request_policy.request_budget_estimate: About 4,000-6,000 one-day calls after local 5m reuse; --preflight is read-only. The hard cap is 7,000 calls, including retries. If the cap would be exceeded, stop without issuing further requests.

validation: Assert 680 unique fixed-pool symbols with every member present in lifecycle coverage, including archive-only symbols with no November prices.
Validate all timestamp values as epoch milliseconds, exact UTC 5m alignment, sorted unique opens, positive prices, valid high/low geometry, and nonnegative volume.
Record effective onboard/delivery evidence, local source lineages, API cache/source, zero-volume bars, real missing 5m opens, incomplete H1 bars, and source conflicts.
Compare common regenerated H1 OHLC in the 2026-09-22..2026-09-24 overlap against the frozen old Binance H1 arrays; report every mismatch and checked-bar count.
Smoke one official 5m day against independent Binance native 1h OHLCV aggregation, and separately check the 2026-09-22 overlap clock.
List local source symbols outside the fixed historical pool in the data manifest; never admit them to the fixed universe.
limitations: Source coverage is restricted to the frozen 680-symbol pool. Local active symbols outside it are listed only as a separate limitation and are not fetched into the cohort.

The 29 archive-only contracts do not have matching records in the frozen current/old exchangeInfo snapshots; their registered historical archive endpoint is not evidence for a new same-name contract lifecycle.
This builder does not change signal eligibility or pricing, and it does not calculate any trade result.
